Title: Osney Bridge Oxford water main/footpath works
Description: Thames towpath diversion via Abbey Road. Water mains replacement and footpath repairs. Phase 2 main works Nov 2024-Aug 2026. Phase 3 decommission July-Oct 2026.

Title: Marsh Lock Henley footbridge closure
Description: Footbridge closed for safety. 3-mile diversion via Shiplake. Closure order valid until 31 Jan 2026 and may be extended. Repairs in design phase, expected late 2026 at earliest.

Title: Sandford Footbridge closure near Oxford
Description: Unsafe footbridge closed north (upstream) of Sandford Lock. Diversion via NCN 5 cycle route. Environment Agency closure due to safety concerns.

Title: Abingdon Weir walkway intermittent closure
Description: Weir walkway closes when river levels high and radial gates operated. Reopened 1 April 2026 with 1.5m width. Closed intermittently due to high flows and trigger points during gate operations.

Title: Temple Footbridge closed Hurley near Marlow
Description: Wooden footbridge closed May 2023 for safety. Unlikely to reopen before 2028. Central span removed Nov 2025. DEFRA offered £250k. Diversion via Marlow Bridge adding 0.5 miles.

Title: Bridge 142 Egham Runnymede footbridge closure
Description: 90-year-old bridge closed Feb 2024 after tree strike. Significant structural damage with cracks in cast iron. Diversion via A308/Causeway/Runnymede Roundabout. Funding for repairs available 2025-26, repairs estimated 2027.

Title: Bell Weir Lock Runnymede diversion for weir works
Description: Thames Path diverted around compound at Runnymede Pleasure Grounds during Bell Weir weir refurbishment works. Lock remains operational. Small diversion around machinery compound.

Title: Streatley-Goring towpath closure eroding bank
Description: 0.8km diversion away from river due to eroding towpath. Repairs expected late 2026 at earliest. Insufficient funding secured. Footpath narrow and frequently floods.

Title: Penton Hook Island tree safety closure
Description: Island closed to public since Feb 2025 due to diseased trees (ash dieback). Scale/complexity of clearing work requires specialist equipment brought by river. Thames Path unaffected. Island remains closed indefinitely.

Title: Ten Foot Bridge Faringdon reconstruction completed
Description: Bridge reconstruction completed 18 Aug 2026. Pedestrian crossing between Rushey and Shifford Locks near Buckland in Faringdon fully restored. Previously closed for reconstruction works.

Title: Brentford Grand Union Canal/Thames junction disruption
Description: Left bank path blocked at Grand Union Canal junction. Being redeveloped. Parts of route now open. Walk down The Ham, cross canal, follow canal to Thames Lock, cross back at lock, follow Dock Road to High Street.
